decisions.reason: The startup accelerator lies far from the machinery core and brings little revenue, so problemistic search and the need to refocus resources on the WASTX plant business make it the most likely product to be quietly removed.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder is a strategic flagship, and the firm's growth gives it slack to carry an uncertain product, even though its distance from the core plant business keeps the risk of dropping it moderate.
The infectious waste plant sits close to the core offer and is backed by the ERMAFA partnership, so management is likely to keep it while results are judged against aspirations.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the modular WASTX line at low incremental cost and fits the decentralized strategy, so there is little reason to drop it.
